own_solution.law: Conservation of angular momentum about the axle; heat = KE lost = (1/2) I1 w^2 * I2/(I1+I2)
assumptions: no external torque about the axle

notes: KE1 = 0.5*0.04*(20 pi)^2 = 78.957 J; heat = 78.957*0.03/0.07 = 33.839 J. With ring, I2 = 0.07: heat = 78.957*0.07/0.11 = 50.245 J. The friction torque sets the slipping time (and the angle slipped) but heat = torque * relative slip angle = the same KE loss, so it cancels (C). T145A has no explicit timing, but present-tense 'is glued' in a static description reads as part of the setup, so R. 'Small' sentences carry no number; treated as non-numeric controls.
